title: Clear automatic archive provenance in runtime-matched Codex thread-state updates
outcome: Runtime-matched Codex archive/unarchive notifications clear prior automatic archive provenance consistently, so a future runtime attachment path cannot preserve stale automatic ownership across a state transition and restart.
acceptance: Runtime-matched thread-state changes clear stale automatic archive provenance while retaining the existing runtime identity guard.
A behavioral notification-and-reload regression verifies that stale automatic ownership cannot authorize automatic unarchive after the thread was restored or archived externally.
